before.name: c. 3000 BC: Harappa is inhabited during the early Ravi phase

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: The archaeological Ravi phase is approximately 3300–2800 BCE; the later mature city dates approximately 2600–1900 BCE. This note describes early settlement, not the founding date or mature city.
r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: Approximate archaeological context; 3000 BCE is a gameplay reference, not a verified exact date.
r2SourceEvidence.location_precision: Archaeological site coordinates; radius is a gameplay setting, not a mapped site boundary.

after.name: c. 3000–2800 BC: Harappa Ravi-phase archaeological context; dates approximate

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: UNESCO tentative-list documentation gives the Ravi aspect at Harappa c.3300–2800 BCE. This bounded game interval is only the c.3000–2800 slice; it does not prove an event or continuous occupation in each year. The Mature Harappan city is later, c.2600–1900. A broad regional Early Harappan note already exists; this one refers specifically to the Harappa site. The original one-year source and before-image remain in the manifest. NewsIndex may repeat context as news in each year.
r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: Approximate archaeological phase; stored interval is a bounded game context, not exact annual occupation or an event every year; includes the reference year 2800.
r2SourceEvidence.location_precision: Archaeological site coordinates; radius is a gameplay setting, not a mapped site boundary.
